name: Ultimate Member Site Kits for Elementor
author: UserElements

sections.description:
Launch an Ultimate Member site faster, not just a widget pack.

If you are building with Ultimate Member, the hard part is not only forms and roles. It is getting to a finished site that already looks coherent: home page, login, register, password reset, profile, member directory, and headers that change for guests and members.

This plugin now leads with Site Kits, starter sites, and Elementor templates for Ultimate Member. Import a complete Ultimate Member site kit in one click, or use the included Elementor widgets to style login, register, password reset, profile, and member directory pages yourself. You get the design layer for Ultimate Member plus the fastest path to a working membership website.

Works with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required. Built specifically for Ultimate Member.

Live Demos | Go Pro | Documentation

Why site owners install this plugin

  • Start with a complete Ultimate Member site kit — Import a working starter site with pages, forms, roles, member directory, and guest/member headers already connected.
  • Skip plugin setup friction — Site Kits can install Elementor and Ultimate Member for you on a new WordPress site.
  • Look branded from day one — Your login, register, password reset, and profile experience matches the rest of the site instead of feeling like plugin defaults.
  • Give members a real directory — AJAX live search and filters help visitors browse and find people fast.
  • Keep editing in Elementor — Change colors, typography, spacing, cards, and fields visually without custom CSS.
  • Use starter sites or page-level templates — Import a full site, or improve only the pages you need.
  • See what Pro starter sites unlock — Free includes one full starter site and preview cards for additional Pro site kits.

Starter sites first. Widgets when you need them.

You can use this plugin in two ways:

  1. Import a starter site — Best for new membership sites, communities, directories, schools, associations, and creator networks.
  2. Style individual Ultimate Member pages in Elementor — Best when you already have a site and only need better login, register, profile, or directory pages.

The free version includes Creator Community, a full Ultimate Member starter site. It gives you a home page, member directory, profile, login, register, password reset, and role-aware headers. Pro unlocks more site kits for different use cases, and Free now shows those Pro kits so users can preview what an upgrade adds.

If you do not want a full import, you can still use the Elementor widgets on existing pages.

What the free version includes

Starter site + Site Kit engine

  • Import Creator Community, a complete Ultimate Member starter site
  • Open Ultimate Member → Site Kits to import, preview, or undo imports
  • Install Elementor and Ultimate Member directly from the Site Kits screen
  • Preview additional Pro site kits from inside Free

Login, register, and password reset in Elementor

  • Login / Register Form widget for Ultimate Member forms
  • Password Reset widget
  • Logout widget
  • Field layout controls: multi-column rows, reorder fields, hide labels, control gaps
  • Visual styling for buttons, inputs, labels, spacing, borders, shadows, colors, and typography

Member directory and user listings

  • Directory Grid with AJAX live search
  • Filter by role or custom Ultimate Member fields
  • Card, list, and custom template layouts
  • Numbered pagination, Load More, or Infinite Scroll
  • Sort by display name, registration date, last login, post count, or custom field
  • Show only approved Ultimate Member members
  • WordPress Users widget works even without Ultimate Member
  • Flip Cards widget for member or team displays

Profile and visibility widgets

  • Profile Photo
  • Profile Fields
  • Profile Name
  • UM Visibility for logged-in, logged-out, role-based, or field-based display rules

Style login, register, and password reset in Elementor

Your login and register pages are where visitors decide whether your site feels trustworthy. This plugin lets you design those pages in Elementor instead of settling for the default Ultimate Member look.

Login / Register Form — One widget handles both forms. Drag it onto your login or register page, choose Login or Register, then style inputs, labels, buttons, typography, spacing, borders, and shadows. Works with your Ultimate Member forms. Login demo | Register demo | Step-by-step login tutorial

Password Reset — Build a branded password reset page that matches the rest of the sign-in flow. Live demo

Logout — Add a clean logout link for logged-in members using your Ultimate Member logout destination.

Build a searchable member directory in Elementor

Starter sites help you launch fast, but directories are still one of the core reasons site owners install this plugin.

Directory Grid — Display Ultimate Member users in responsive card or list layouts. Visitors search by name and results update instantly with AJAX. Filter by role or custom UM fields, choose numbered pagination, Load More, or Infinite Scroll, and sort by display name, registration date, last login, post count, or a custom field. Live demo | Directory tutorial

WordPress Users — List native WordPress users by role and user meta. Useful for staff directories, teams, authors, and contributor pages. Works without Ultimate Member installed.

Flip Cards — Create hover-to-flip profile cards for member spotlights, team sections, or featured users. Live demo

Profile widgets for Ultimate Member pages

Use Elementor to clean up and personalize Ultimate Member profile pages.

Profile Photo — Standalone avatar widget with size, border, radius, and filter controls. Profile page demo

Profile Fields — Output any mix of Ultimate Member fields for the viewed member. Supports text, URL, phone, image, and file fields with visibility rules. Live demo

Profile Name — Show the profile user’s display name, first name, last name, full name, username, or nickname with Elementor typography controls. Live demo

UM Visibility — Show or hide Elementor sections by login state, user role, or field value conditions.

Get started in minutes

This plugin is built for a faster first launch.

  1. Activate the plugin — Site Kits opens automatically.
  2. Choose a starter site — Import Creator Community from Ultimate Member → Site Kits.
  3. Install dependencies if needed — The importer can install Elementor and Ultimate Member from WordPress.org.
  4. Customize in Elementor — Change colors, fonts, spacing, and layouts.
  5. Or skip the full import — Start with login, register, password reset, or directory widgets on your existing pages.

Site Kit imports can be undone from the Site Kits screen. Per-page starter templates also back up your previous Elementor layout before applying changes.

Find widgets in the Elementor panel under UM Core Pages (forms and profile fields) and Directory Layouts (directory grids and flip cards).

Why this is different from a normal Ultimate Member addon

Most Ultimate Member plugins add one widget or one admin feature. This plugin is meant to get you from a fresh WordPress site to a branded member-ready website faster.

It combines:

  • Starter sites / Site Kits for complete Ultimate Member website imports
  • Elementor widgets for login, register, password reset, profile, and member directory pages
  • Setup tools like dependency install, starter templates, and import undo
  • Upgrade previews so free users can see the Pro site kits and advanced member widgets available later

More free Ultimate Member tools from UserElements

These free plugins work great alongside Ultimate Member Widgets for Elementor. Install them from Ultimate Member → Our Plugins or Settings → Our Plugins:

  • Member Export for Ultimate Member — Export and import member data as CSV with filters, column mapping, and saved presets
  • SEO for Ultimate Member — Privacy-aware profile sitemap, Yoast & Rank Math integration, Person schema, and Open Graph tags
  • Faceted Search for Ultimate Member — Filter sidebar for member directories with live AJAX facet counts

Upgrade to Pro when you need more

The free plugin gives you one full Ultimate Member starter site plus the core Elementor widgets for auth pages, profiles, and directories. Ultimate Member Site Kits Pro for Elementor expands that with more site kits and advanced member widgets:

  • More starter sites / Site Kits — Alumni, startup, church, school, healthcare, and other Pro site kits visible from the Free library
  • Account Page — Style Ultimate Member account tabs in Elementor

  • Profile Page Builder — Replace the default Ultimate Member profile template with a custom Elementor layout

  • Member Carousel — Touch-friendly slider for featured members, alumni spotlights, or testimonials

  • Member Table — Sortable directory with clickable column headers, global AJAX search, and CSV / Excel export. Tutorial
  • Member Filter — Standalone filter panel with unlimited fields, dropdowns, checkboxes, and radio buttons
  • Member Card Grid — Multi-column and zigzag directory layouts
  • Member Search — Dedicated AJAX search bar, independent of the directory grid
  • Faceted Search — Multi-criteria live filtering with real-time AJAX refresh
  • UM Directory Styler — Full Elementor visual control over the native Ultimate Member directory shortcode
  • Member Loop Grid, Split View, and Alphabet Index — Advanced directory layouts with Elementor templates, side-panel browsing, and A–Z name navigation

See all Pro features and live demos →

Pricing: Free — unlimited sites. Pro from $45/year. All Access bundle also available.

Do not activate Free and Pro together. Pro replaces Free.

What users say

“I have been seeking sortable user data tables for quite some time. Finally found it.” – ★★★★★ @nikotor · WordPress.org

“I am new to Elementor and WP and this plugin has been a real help. Takes a lot of guesswork and effort out of the process.” – ★★★★★ @hawkekeye · WordPress.org

Read all reviews →

Who is this for?

  • Beginners who want to launch an Ultimate Member starter site instead of assembling pages manually
  • Membership site owners who need a branded login, register, profile, and directory experience
  • Community builders creating searchable, filterable member directories in Elementor
  • Agencies who want a faster Ultimate Member starting point for client projects
  • Schools, churches, associations, and creator communities that want a niche-relevant starter site
  • Directory-style businesses and marketplaces where people browse, search, and filter members or professionals
sections.installation:
1. Install this plugin via Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip file manually, then activate it.
  2. Site Kits opens automatically. Go to Ultimate Member → Site Kits any time.
  3. Import Creator Community, the free Ultimate Member starter site.
  4. If Elementor or Ultimate Member are missing, let the importer install them from WordPress.org.
  5. Fine-tune colors, fonts, pages, and member-facing layouts in Elementor.
  6. Optional: skip the full starter site and apply widgets or starter templates to individual pages instead.
  7. Optional: open Ultimate Member → Our Plugins (or Settings → Our Plugins) to install related free Ultimate Member add-ons from UserElements.

Full walkthrough: plugin documentation
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It helps you launch and design an Ultimate Member website faster. Import a complete starter site in one click, or style login, register, password reset, profile, and member directory pages in Elementor without code.

What is a starter site or Site Kit?

A Site Kit is a starter site for Ultimate Member. It can include a home page, login page, register page, password reset page, profile page, member directory, Ultimate Member forms, roles, options, and guest/member headers. The free version includes Creator Community and also previews locked Pro site kits.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. All free widgets and starter site imports work with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required.

Do I need Ultimate Member?

Ultimate Member is recommended for login, register, password reset, profile, and member directory features. The WordPress Users widget works on any WordPress site without Ultimate Member.

Is this plugin good for beginners?

Yes. The plugin now starts with Site Kits so a new user can import a ready-made Ultimate Member starter site instead of configuring everything from scratch. You can still edit everything later in Elementor.

How do I import the free starter site?

Activate the plugin, open Ultimate Member → Site Kits, and import Creator Community. If Elementor or Ultimate Member are not installed yet, the importer can install them for you.

How do I style the Ultimate Member login page in Elementor?

Install the plugin, open your login page in the Elementor editor, and add the Login / Register Form widget. Choose Login in the Content tab. Use the Style tab to change colors, fonts, input borders, button styles, background, padding, and spacing. Every change updates in real time. Publish when done. Login demo | Step-by-step guide: How to Style the Ultimate Member Login Page with Elementor.

How do I style the Ultimate Member register form in Elementor?

Use the same Login / Register Form widget. Switch the form type to Register in the Content tab, then style field labels, inputs, section headers, submit button, and error messages visually. Both login and register are included free. Register demo

Can I style the Ultimate Member password reset page in Elementor?

Yes. The Password Reset widget is included free. Style it to match your login and register forms so the full sign-in flow looks consistent. Live demo

How do I build a member directory in Elementor?

Add the Directory Grid widget. Choose card or list layout, enable AJAX live search, add role or custom field filters, and configure pagination (numbered, Load More, or Infinite Scroll). Use WordPress Users if you only need native WordPress users without Ultimate Member. Full walkthrough: Create a WordPress Membership Directory in Elementor.

Can I filter my member directory by custom Ultimate Member fields?

Yes. The free Directory Grid supports AJAX meta field filters with no page reload. The free version supports up to two filter fields. Pro adds a standalone Member Filter widget with unlimited fields, dropdowns, checkboxes, and radio buttons.

Can I show only approved Ultimate Member users in the directory?

Yes. Enable Show Only Approved Users in the Directory Grid Content tab to list only members whose UM account status is approved.

Can I sort the member directory by last login or a custom field?

Yes. Sort by display name, first name, last name, registration date, last login, post count, user ID, or any custom meta field — all from the Elementor widget panel.

Can I build a custom Ultimate Member profile page in Elementor?

Yes, with Pro. The Profile Page Builder provides dedicated Elementor widgets that replace the default UM profile template: cover photo, header, bio, meta fields, social links, action bar, completion bar, custom tabs, and profile body. See How to Customize the Ultimate Member Profile Page.

Can I display members in a sortable table with CSV export?

Yes, with Pro. The Member Table widget supports clickable column sorting, global AJAX search, and one-click CSV export of the filtered member list. Step-by-step guide: Display Ultimate Member Users in an Elementor Table.

Can I add a member carousel or slider in Elementor?

Yes, with Pro. The Member Carousel uses Swiper.js for smooth, touch-friendly sliding — ideal for homepage featured members and testimonials.

Can I use the free and Pro versions together?

No. Pro replaces Free. Deactivate one before activating the other.

Is this compatible with caching plugins like WP Rocket or LiteSpeed Cache?

Yes. If AJAX or directory scripts fail after minification, exclude wp-content/plugins/ultimate-member-widgets-for-elementor/assets/js/ from your caching plugin’s JavaScript processing.

Does this work on WordPress multisite?

Yes. Each site in the network operates independently with its own user query scope.

Where can I see live demos?

Visit demo.userelements.com — interactive demos for every widget. No login required.
sections.changelog:
2.9.4

  • Added: Role-aware UM Site Headers — build Elementor headers for guests, logged-in members, or specific Ultimate Member roles (Ultimate Member → Site Headers). Optional theme header hide, priority matching, and [um_site_header] shortcode.
  • Added: Member Header Nav widget — Login/Register for guests; avatar, profile, account, directory, and logout for members, plus optional role-specific extra links.
  • Added: Visual layout image-selector in the Elementor editor for Member Directory Grid and WordPress User Grid — pick Card, List, or Custom Template from thumbnail previews instead of icon/dropdown controls. Locked Pro Table and Carousel options keep the upgrade tooltip and notice.
  • Fixed: Directory Grid pagination totals no longer come from a limited page query, so 100 users per page paginates the full member pool instead of greying out the pager.
  • Added: Site Kits — import a complete membership site (pages, UM forms, roles, directory, guest/member headers). Creator Community is bundled free. Pro kits stay locked without a Pro licence.
  • Added: One-click installer for Elementor and Ultimate Member from the Site Kits screen, so a new WordPress site can go from this plugin to a working membership site without hunting for dependencies.
  • Added: Role-aware UM Site Footers (Ultimate Member → Site Footers), used by Site Kits.
  • Added: Hidden widget aliases so Pro widget names (umep-* and um-user-profile-avatar) still render in Free. Existing pages that use um-login-register-styler, umwfe-member-header-nav, um-user-avatar, and the other Free widget IDs are unchanged.
  • Improved: Setup wizard, plugin action links, and the first-run notice now lead with Site Kits.
  • Improved: This plugin can activate without Elementor already installed, so the Site Kits importer can install Elementor for you.
  • This release repositions the plugin as the design layer for Ultimate Member. Widget IDs on existing pages are not renamed.

2.9.3

  • Fixed: User Directory Grid role filter was ignored — selected roles (including custom Ultimate Member roles) now correctly limit the directory on initial render and AJAX search/pagination.

2.9.2

  • Added: Our Plugins admin page — discover and one-click install related free UserElements Ultimate Member plugins (Member Export, SEO for Ultimate Member, Faceted Search). Available under Ultimate Member → Our Plugins and Settings → Our Plugins.

2.9.1

  • Fixed: Fatal error with Elementor Pro Theme Builder — UM_Condition_Base::get_priority() is now static to match Elementor Pro’s Condition_Base signature.

2.9

  • Added: Custom Template layout on Member Directory Grid and WordPress User Grid — pick an Elementor library template (Loop Item / Container / Section) and render it once per member. UM dynamic tags resolve per card. Card and List layouts are unchanged.
  • Improved: Elementor 4.2 compatibility — declared “Elementor tested up to: 4.2.0” and enforce a minimum Elementor 3.5.0 version with an admin notice when older.
  • Improved: Directory list widgets use Elementor’s elementsHandler.attachHandler lifecycle (with legacy element_ready fallback) and expose pagination/layout settings via frontend_available for data-settings.
  • Improved: AJAX directory handlers read saved widget settings through Elementor’s Documents API instead of walking raw _elementor_data meta.
  • Improved: Soft Ultimate Member dependency — WordPress User Grid works without UM; UM widgets and AJAX register only when Ultimate Member is active, with a clear admin notice when it is missing.
  • Fixed: Profile Photo dynamic tag now uses Elementor Data_Tag for Image controls; added a separate Profile Photo URL tag for URL controls.
  • Fixed: Member Avatar and Member Name widgets used the deprecated _register_controls() method — migrated to register_controls().
  • Fixed: Member and profile widgets mark themselves as dynamic content and respect Elementor’s optimized markup experiment (has_widget_inner_wrapper).
  • Fixed: WordPress User Grid now initializes correctly in the Elementor editor/preview via the frontend handler API.
  • Added: Lightweight editor content_template() placeholders for directory widgets.

2.8

  • Added: Field Layout for the Login & Register Form widget — arrange UM form fields visually: set widths (full, 2/3, half, 1/3) for multi-column rows, reorder fields, hide labels, and control column gap. Pure CSS on UM’s own field wrappers; fields and validation stay managed in Ultimate Member, so nothing can desync.
  • Added: Setup wizard — a guided 3-step first-run flow (requirements check, per-page starter designs, finish) that launches on activation and stays reachable from the Elementor Setup screen.
  • Added: Starter templates — one-click Elementor layouts for the Login, Register, Password Reset, and Members Directory pages, applied to the mapped UM core page and opened straight in the editor.
  • Added: Automatic layout backups — the previous Elementor layout of a page is saved before a starter template is applied and can be restored from the Elementor Setup screen.
  • Improved: Widgets renamed into one consistent “Member” family (Member Login & Register Form, Member Password Reset, Member Flip Cards, Member Avatar, Member Name, Member Fields, WordPress User Grid, Logout Link) — panel search now finds every widget by natural keywords.
  • Improved: Every widget links its Elementor “Need Help?” button to the matching tutorial or documentation page.
  • Improved: The Members Directory page is no longer marked Pro in the wizard and setup dashboard — build it with the free Member Directory Grid; styling UM’s native directory shortcode remains a Pro widget.
  • Improved: Admin menu entries renamed to “Member Pages” (Settings + Ultimate Member) for a single product surface across free and Pro.
  • Added: Free vs Pro comparison table on the setup screen with per-feature demo links.
  • Added: Editor guidance when a directory query matches no members on a new site.
  • Added: “Hide locked Pro widgets” option under Member Pages → Advanced.
  • Added: One-time success toast after applying a starter template, with next-step guidance.
  • Removed: Unused bundled image; tightened upgrade-notice copy.
  • Fixed: Member directory widgets were capped at 100 users regardless of widget settings. Queries now respect Number of Members (up to 1000) and Users Per Page, including AJAX directory requests.

2.7

  • Fixed: Removed duplicate legacy admin upgrade notice that could not be dismissed on Plugins/Dashboard screens.
  • Fixed: In-editor Pro placeholder upgrade links now use centralized URLs with UTM attribution instead of a hardcoded price.
  • Security: AJAX directory endpoints no longer trust client-supplied widget_settings query keys; meta filters are constrained to widget-exposed fields.
  • Improved: New query engine enabled by default; cache invalidation only runs for directory-relevant meta changes.

2.6

  • Added: UM Login & Register Form widget — style Ultimate Member login and register forms visually in Elementor.
  • Added: Password Reset widget — complete your styled authentication flow in Elementor.
  • Added: Pro widget placeholders in the Elementor editor — free users see upgrade cards for locked Pro widgets on the canvas.

2.5

  • Security: AJAX filter endpoints now verify nonce before any file I/O or class loading.
  • Security: meta_query items from widget_settings are sanitized before reaching WP_User_Query.
  • Security: per_page in the UM AJAX handler clamped to a maximum of 100.
  • Security: debug output gated behind WP_DEBUG on all error paths.
  • Security: email address removed from default public meta fields in WP User List handler.
  • Fixed: sort order control works for all options — ID, first/last name, last login, post count, email.
  • Fixed: box shadow control uses Group_Control_Box_Shadow.
  • Fixed: admin notice dismiss nonce mismatch caused silent dismiss failures.
  • Fixed: PHP fatal when Elementor is inactive — undefined admin notice callbacks.
  • Fixed: deprecated Elementor Scheme_Color and Scheme_Typography imports in flip card widget.
  • Fixed: widget category sometimes did not appear due to hook registration timing.
  • Fixed: meta key selector uncached table scan on every editor load — results cached one hour.
  • Fixed: Pro layout values in database caused user cards to disappear — now fall back to card layout.
  • Fixed: widget order_by and order settings not passed to the query engine.
  • Added: Table and Carousel layout options visible in free widget with upgrade tooltip.
  • Added: meta cache primed after user queries to avoid N+1 meta fetches.
  • Added: query result transients invalidated on user profile, meta, or role changes.
  • Improved: user-processing loop unified into shared static methods across AJAX handlers.
  • Improved: pro upgrade notice scoped to admin-only roles and screens.
